look_here_first: Look for the branched or scrambling perennial habit, long stinging hairs, narrow toothed leaves, and a small raceme with few male flowers and usually one female flower. Confirm with leaf base, pedicel bases, and fruit.

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: perennial subshrub with erect to trailing or scrambling stems

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: linear-lanceolate to narrowly ovate serrate leaves

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: leaf bases truncate to weakly cordate

lookalikes.differences: Narrower leaves with truncate to weakly cordate bases plus the raceme/pedicel characters distinguish it from the local Tragia set; reproductive structures should confirm the ID.
